title: Exhaust fan discharge.
officialText:
Exhaust fans shall be positioned so that the discharge will not impinge on the roof, other equipment or
appliances or parts of the structure. A vertical discharge fan serving a Type 1 hood shall be manufactured with an approved drain
outlet at the lowest point of the housing to permit drainage of grease to an approved grease reservoir.
